name: Snow Memory
source:
Four girls pass the casting to work in a Western mansion. You choose one of the girls and watch the forthcoming events from her point of view. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/07/vn-of-month-january-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
